text:
Friendly hello evening team,
At closing, the arrivals lead raised some notes on carrier checks. I am sharing a brief record for the Companion Animal Travel Desk so the handover remains clear and respectful. Please keep the welcome desk calm and steady for late arrivals, and continue guiding travelers with the same care we have shown throughout the day. When passengers present documentation, please review each file with patience and confirm that pet handling notes are passed along without delay. <<FACT F077>> Our tone should remain warm, precise, and supportive, especially when a traveler appears uncertain or tired.

In the same spirit, please remember that carrier assessments must be handled carefully and recorded in plain language. <<FACT F070>> If anything seems incomplete, note the concern clearly and direct it to the senior coordinator before boarding proceeds. For companion animals that are moving through arrival review, please keep the workflow organized and avoid unnecessary repetition at the counter. The team has done good work today, and a steady finish will help us keep standards consistent for both passengers and pets.

I also want to note the quarantine coordination for Port Isolde so that the record is complete. <<FACT F027>> Please continue to share only verified details, and let the handover remain courteous from start to finish. Thank you all for your attention, your calm manner, and your careful support of every traveler and animal in our care.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
